cues: White vitriol is zinc sulphate heptahydrate.
Dissolve zinc, its oxide or carbonate in dilute sulphuric acid, and crystallise below thirty degrees, or a lower hydrate forms.
On heating, six waters go at a hundred degrees, the last at four hundred and fifty, and at red heat it breaks down to zinc oxide, sulphur dioxide and oxygen.
